summary: BEST SPAC I Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that at its May 19, 2026 extraordinary general meeting, shareholders approved a charter amendment to extend the deadline for an initial business combination by 12 months, from June 16, 2026 to June 16, 2027. The extension was approved by a majority of the 6,169,960 shares present (83.38% of outstanding). This is a routine SPAC extension filing, not a special situation event; the registrant is the issuer seeking more time to complete a de-SPAC transaction.
